messages:
Maya Patel: Heads up — we identified onboarding webhook failures over the weekend that blocked tenant provisioning for a subset of customers (mostly EU). I'm preparing an outbound comms plan + RCA. Need quick alignment on a credit offer and office-hours cadence for high-touch accounts.

CS Bot: [INC-2026] created for onboarding-webhook-failures; ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026 :rotating_light:

Ethan Lee: Can you share the affected list? prioritize anyone flagged as high renewal risk pls.

Maya Patel: Short extract (redacted) — ~72 tenants impacted, 14 flagged as HIGH renewal risk. Saved to //share/cs/impacted-INC-2026.csv.

Ruth Carter: Proposal: tier A (enterprise/high renewal) = 1:1 office hours + credit equal to 1 week of committed usage; tier B (mid-market) = group office hours + prorated credit; tier C (low-touch) = tailored email + self-serve troubleshooting guide.

Diego Morales: For the 1:1s I can run Tue/Wed 13:00–17:00 UTC. Recommend offering 30 or 60 minute slots depending on complexity. Need calendar invite template we can reuse.

Maya Patel: Draft email below — please review and edit inline.

```
Hi <Customer>,

We're reaching out because we experienced a provisioning delay impacting tenant creation during the weekend of <DATE>. Our engineering team identified a webhook retry bug that prevented some onboarding jobs from completing. We have:
- Replayed failed jobs and completed manual re-syncs (completed 03:10 UTC).
- Implemented a temporary retry backoff fix and deployed a hotpatch.

We sincerely apologize for the disruption. To make this right, we're offering a credit of <CREDIT AMOUNT> and would like to invite you to a 1:1 office hour to review any outstanding issues and walk through recovery steps. Please pick a time here: <calendar-link>.

If you prefer self-serve, please follow this guide: <kb-link>.

Regards,
Maya Patel
Redwood Customer Success
```

Ruth Carter: Add a short mitigation bullet in the email: "Manual re-sync completed at 03:10 UTC; no data loss detected." Also include a sentence about preventative measures and ETA for permanent fix.

Ethan Lee: Can we confirm finance/legal ok with the credit language? We should avoid promising SLA refunds — stick to goodwill credits unless prod states otherwise.

Maya Patel: Noted. I'll keep it as "goodwill credit". Looping billing/legal via email after we finalize amounts — will tag here once done.

CS Bot: Office hours event created: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/INC-2026-office-hours (slots TBD).

Diego Morales: I'll own scheduling/invites for Tier A and send calendar invites with the template. Posting the invite template in #cs-templates shortly.

Ruth Carter: I'll draft a 2-question feedback survey to send after the session: (1) Did the office hour resolve the onboarding issue? (2) How satisfied are you with the remediation? Quick NPS-ish options.

Maya Patel: Thanks team. Plan: finalize email + credit amounts tonight, start outbound tomorrow 08:00 UTC for Tier A, then Tier B group sessions later in the week. Will tag AEs/owners in each outbound so they can prep talking points.

Ethan Lee: Please tag priority accounts in thread when you send so AE can align.

Maya Patel: Will do. :thumbsup:
